stories.message: Could not sign in as the owner to reach /manage/menu. The admin password sign-in control on /login (revealed via 'Admin? Sign in with a password') accepts input into the email and password fields, but clicking its submit control never issues any network request, reproduced across many distinct click-targeting strategies (the generic submit button, the toggle itself via its aria name 'Sign in', xpath-positional buttons 1-4, CSS sibling selectors after the password input, following::button[1]) each time with valid admin credentials filled in. The backend endpoint is sound: POST /AuthApi/password with the admin's real email+password returns 200 with the admin user object when called directly outside the browser. browser_sign_in has no admin/password-role support. Visiting /manage afterward always redirects back to /login, confirming no session was ever established through the UI.
evidence: Every UI click path tried (button[type=submit], aria/Sign in[role=button], xpath (//button)[1..4], input[type=password]+button, input[type=password]~button, input[type=password]/following::button[1]) with both fields filled produced zero network requests and zero console errors
GET /preview/manage after each attempt still renders the sign-in page, not the admin hub

stories.message: Same blocker as add-menu-item-works: the owner cannot be authenticated through the browser UI (the password sign-in control never fires a request despite valid credentials), so /manage/menu could not be reached to test editing an existing item.
evidence: Identical reproduction as add-menu-item-works: POST /AuthApi/password succeeds when called directly (200, admin role) but no UI control ever calls it or anything else

stories.message: Creating an account works and signs the visitor in immediately (POST /AuthApi/register -> 201, followed by a working /account and /my-orders). But signing in again later with that same email and password fails: after Sign out and returning to the Sign in tab with the identical credentials just used to register, POST /AuthApi/password returns 403 {"error":"invalid email or password"} and the page shows that message. Reproduced end-to-end twice with two independently created accounts (qa-customer-test1@example.com and qa-customer-test2@example.com), both failing identically immediately after sign-out. The same /AuthApi/password endpoint works correctly for the pre-seeded admin account when hit directly, so the endpoint logic itself runs; something about how a self-registered password is stored does not match what the login check verifies against.
evidence: POST /preview/AuthApi/register 201 for qa-customer-test2@example.com; GET /AuthApi/me 200; /account and /my-orders render the new account correctly
After Sign out -> /login -> Sign in tab -> same email/password -> submit: POST /preview/AuthApi/password 403 body {"error":"invalid email or password"}
Reproduced identically with a second account, qa-customer-test1@example.com / TestPass123!

stories.message: Signed in as a freshly self-registered customer, added Margherita to the basket and completed pickup checkout. POST /CheckoutApi/order returned 201 and the confirmation page rendered identically to the guest flow (order code, status Received, payment Pay at store, fulfilment Pickup, estimated ready time, items, total, name). Afterward GET /my-orders listed that same order under the signed-in account.
evidence: POST /preview/CheckoutApi/order 201 while signed in as qa-customer-test3@example.com
GET /preview/OrderConfirmationApi/Sk6WURUieFkHmqlywn78Kr93G4ucuyUn 200, confirmation page matched the guest-order layout
GET /preview/my-orders 200 afterward listed 'Order Sk6WURUieFkHmqlywn78Kr93G4ucuyUn ... 1 × Margherita £9.50 Total £9.50'

stories.message: Signed in as a self-registered customer (qa-customer-test3@example.com), /my-orders lists the account's own order with date (Nov 14, 2026), items (1 × Margherita, £9.50), total (£9.50) and status (Received). Separately placed a guest order with no session (a different item, order id mZ6PG3wVqKfxaEInX79snJuXMuK01nq_); reloading the signed-in customer's /my-orders afterward still showed only their own single order — the guest order does not appear. Also checked the seeded 'member' account (customer1@example.com, link sign-in): its /my-orders correctly shows no orders rather than member2's known order (id 42a35c74-41e5-45d6-b7ce-57b90a5edb6c, owner u_bc8ff7bc9cbcf078d9e537b9b6098f8d), consistent with correct per-account filtering.
evidence: GET /preview/my-orders 200 as qa-customer-test3@example.com showed exactly one dated order with items/total/status
Guest order (POST /CheckoutApi/order 201, id mZ6PG3wVqKfxaEInX79snJuXMuK01nq_) placed with no session did not appear on re-check of qa-customer-test3's /my-orders
member (customer1@example.com) /my-orders shows 'You don't have any orders on this account yet', never member2's row

stories.message: Could not sign in as the owner to reach the menu editor and test photo upload: the admin password sign-in control on /login never submits (see add-menu-item-works). browser_sign_in has no admin/password role. MenuPhotoAdminApi correctly refuses anonymous access with 403, confirming the endpoint exists and is access-controlled, but its upload behaviour could not be exercised without an owner session.
evidence: Admin password login never fires a request (see add-menu-item-works evidence)

stories.message: The 'no photo renders the menu as today, with no broken image' half is verified: GET /MenuApi shows photoUrl: null for every current item, and the public home page renders all items normally (name, description, price, Add button) with no broken-image indicators. The 'item with a photo shows it' half could not be verified: no item in the current data has a photo, and creating one requires the owner's menu editor, which is unreachable because admin password sign-in does not work in the UI (see add-menu-item-works). Reported not_testable rather than a pass since only one half of the acceptance could be demonstrated.
evidence: GET /preview/MenuApi 200: every item across Pizzas/Sides/Drinks has "photoUrl":null
Home page (/) renders the full menu with names/descriptions/prices/Add buttons and no broken images, consistent with the no-photo case

defects.message: The owner cannot sign in with a password through /login. The password fields fill fine, but no click target ever submits them: the one true submit button always posts to /AuthApi/request-link regardless of toggle state or password content; every other candidate fires no request and no console error. /AuthApi/password works when called directly. This blocks every owner-only screen, including the menu-editor and order-status fixes this release targeted.

A self-registered customer cannot sign in again with the password just used to create the account: POST /AuthApi/password returns 403 'invalid email or password' right after sign-out. Reproduced with two independent accounts. See customer-create-account story.

notes: Admin (owner) stories could not be functionally tested because the password sign-in control on /login does not work from the browser; the backend auth endpoint is fine when hit directly, so this reads as a frontend wiring defect in the password-login submit control, separate from the 400-on-write bug this release targeted. Two customer-facing stories (order-linked-to-account, view-past-orders) passed via a self-registered account. Account creation works, but re-login afterward is broken. anonymousAccess and roleEscalation both passed across all five protected resources named in the plan.
